items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: He was a singer just to come in and do that one number with the band, you know.

ctx.x: And there was a vocalist on that, and I remember you told me that it was Jesse Crier(?).
That's right. That's right. He was just a singer. That's all he ever did, was sing. He was a singer just to come in and do that one number with the band, you know. Yeah, Jesse Crier.
So he must have been there, then, when Razaf came in.
